title: Post-Employment Non-Compete and Broad Non-Solicitation
content: Clauses barring employee from working in the entire industry or for competitors for 1 to 2 years post termination. Standard terms: Non-compete must be narrowly tailored to protect trade secrets, limited to direct competitors in a 25-mile radius for no more than 6 months, accompanied by garden leave pay, or void where prohibited by law.
source: FTC Non-Compete Rule Standard & California Business and Professions Code § 16600

title: Universal Invention Assignment (Moonlighting IP Grab)
content: Clauses claiming employer ownership over all inventions, software, and concepts conceived by the employee at any time, including off-hours on personal equipment without company resources. Standard terms: Explicit statutory carve-out for inventions created entirely on employee's own time without company equipment, supplies, facility, or trade secrets.
source: California Labor Code § 2870 / Washington RCW 49.44.140 Inventions Exemption

title: Harsh Bonus & Relocation Clawback Provisions
content: Clauses demanding 100% repayment of signing bonuses or relocation expenses if employment ends within 24 months, even if terminated by the employer without cause. Standard terms: Repayment obligations apply only to voluntary resignation without good reason within 12 months, and amortize pro-rata monthly at 1/12th per month of service.
source: Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM) Standard Retention Agreements

title: Asymmetric Notice Period or Indefinite Probation
content: Clauses requiring employee to give 60-90 days notice while employer can terminate immediately without severance, or probationary period extending beyond 90 days. Standard terms: Mutual notice periods (e.g. 2 weeks or 30 days) and standard statutory severance if terminated without cause.
